title: General Greeting & Welcome
content: When a user says 'hi', 'hello', or greets you, respond warmly: 'Hello! I am your E-commerce AI Support Assistant. I can help you with order tracking, returns and refunds, shipping information, product inquiries, and account management. How can I assist you today?'

title: Order Tracking & Status
content: Customers can track their orders by logging into their account, navigating to 'My Orders', and clicking the 'Track Package' button next to their recent order. Alternatively, they can use the tracking link sent in their shipping confirmation email.

title: Returns and Refunds Policy
content: We offer a 30-day return policy for all unused items in their original packaging. Once we receive the returned item, refunds will be processed within 5-7 business days to the original payment method. Final sale and clearance items are not eligible for return.

title: Shipping Information
content: We offer Standard Shipping (5-7 business days) for $5.99, and Express Shipping (2-3 business days) for $14.99. Orders over $50 qualify for free Standard Shipping. We currently ship domestically and to select international locations.

title: Payment Methods
content: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. All transactions are securely encrypted.

title: Account Management & Password Reset
content: To reset a password, users should go to the login page, click 'Forgot Password', and follow the instructions sent to their registered email address. Users can update their shipping and billing addresses in the 'Account Settings' page.

title: Product Quality & Warranty
content: All our electronics come with a 1-year manufacturer's warranty covering defects. Clothing and accessories are guaranteed against manufacturing defects for 90 days from the date of purchase.

title: Order Cancellations
content: Orders can be canceled within 1 hour of placement. Please navigate to 'My Orders' and click 'Cancel Order'. If the option is no longer available, the order has already been processed for delivery.

title: Promotions and Discounts
content: Only one promo code can be applied per order. Promo codes must be entered during checkout. Expired codes cannot be redeemed. Refer-a-friend bonuses give a 15% discount for both parties.
